description: This header file defines macros and configurations for the GCC linker toolchain used in the Zephyr RTOS, including architecture-specific output formats and memory section macros.

methods.name: GROUP_START
methods.description: Defines the start of a memory section group.

methods.name: GROUP_END
methods.description: Defines the end of a memory section group.

methods.name: GROUP_LINK_IN
methods.description: Routes memory sections to a specified memory area.

methods.name: GROUP_ROM_LINK_IN
methods.description: Routes read-only memory sections, possibly in flash.

methods.name: GROUP_DATA_LINK_IN
methods.description: Routes read-write data sections, possibly for XIP platforms.

methods.name: GROUP_NOLOAD_LINK_IN
methods.description: Routes sections that are not loaded, such as BSS or noinit.

methods.name: SECTION_PROLOGUE
methods.description: Defines the beginning of a section with optional alignment.

methods.name: SECTION_DATA_PROLOGUE
methods.description: Defines the beginning of a data section, handling virtual and load addresses.
